what_is_tested: Label content vs. finished product, heavy metals, microbes, mycotoxins, pesticides, 290+ banned substances, facility audit
notes: Strictest widely available program; annual recertification and facility inspection.

what_is_tested: Finished-product content vs. label, contaminants; no banned-substance screen
notes: Useful for label accuracy but not an anti-doping guarantee.

what_is_tested: Every batch screened for 285+ prohibited substances in ISO 17025 labs, plus manufacturing quality review
notes: Best batch-level assurance; a product, not a brand, is certified.

what_is_tested: Retail monitoring: at least 12 random lots per year screened for prohibited substances
notes: Weaker than Informed Sport because not every batch is tested.

what_is_tested: Identity, potency, contaminants, dissolution; manufacturing facility audit and off-the-shelf retesting
notes: Strong on label accuracy and contaminants; almost no protein powders participate.

what_is_tested: Heavy metals, bisphenols, pesticides, and other industrial contaminants against Prop 65-linked benchmarks
notes: Advocacy-run program; its 2025 category study is a key data source in this review.

what_is_tested: Retail-sample assays for label accuracy and heavy metals, graded A-F
notes: Useful secondary signal; methodology and sample dates are not always disclosed.

what_is_tested: Whatever the brand chooses to publish
notes: Not a certification; verify the lab, lot number, and date.
